#include <iostream>

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    bool res = true;
    while (m > 0) {
        int rem = m % w;
        if (rem == 0 || rem == 1) {
            m /= w;
            continue;
        }
        if (rem == w - 1) {
            m++;
            continue;
        }
        res = false;
        break;
    }

    std::cout << (res ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
